facts.text: The hotel has two temperature-controlled outdoor pools, a seafront hot tub and access to the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Choose from two temperature-controlled pools, a seafront hot tub, or the Caribbean Sea.

facts.text: Thatched-roof beach villas can be reserved on the beach at an additional cost.
The thatched beach villas accommodate up to four adults.
facts.excerpt: These exquisite thatched-roof beach villas are designed to accommodate up to four adults

facts.text: The Club Lounge is on the eighth floor and is for guests staying in Club rooms and suites.
facts.excerpt: Conveniently appointed on the eighth floor,

facts.text: The Club Lounge looks over the sunset on Nichupte Lagoon.
facts.excerpt: views of the sunset over the Nichupté Lagoon

facts.text: The tennis courts are beside the lagoon and are available to all hotel guests, booked through the concierge team.
facts.excerpt: The courts are available to all hotel guests. Just book your preferred time through our concierge team.

facts.text: The hotel has pickleball courts with official measurements and lighting.
facts.excerpt: as they have official measurements and lighting

facts.text: Instructors teach beginners the rules of pickleball.
facts.excerpt: we also have instructors who can teach you the rules of the game

facts.text: The hotel has a spa, a fitness center and a kids' club.
facts.excerpt: including a spa, fitness center, and kids' club

facts.text: A host known as the Lady in Red, dressed in red, welcomes each guest and gives personalized assistance and local knowledge.
facts.excerpt: Clad in a vibrant shade of red, she welcomes each guest with warmth and grace, offering personalized assistance and insider knowledge about the hotel and the local area.

facts.text: Companion dogs up to 15 kg (33 lb) are admitted under the Kempinski Paws program.
A dog's stay under Kempinski Paws needs prior confirmation by the hotel and is subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: Participation in Kempinski Paws is subject to availability and prior confirmation by Kempinski Hotel Cancún.

facts.text: Extra rollaway beds are only available in rooms and suites with a king-size bed.
facts.excerpt: Extra rollaway beds are only available in rooms and suites with a king-size bed.

facts.text: The hotel operates a non-smoking policy.
Boutique Narita, inside the hotel, sells international fashion, including the Camilla and La Perla boutiques.
facts.excerpt: Nestled within Kempinski Hotel Cancún, Boutique Narita offers an exclusive selection of international fashion

facts.text: The concierge team can secure show seats and make restaurant reservations.
